purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Kuresoi South Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 150 DPI directly from a freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved). This particular scan is watermarked 'COPY' across every page (a certified duplicate rather than the original scan) but is otherwise a clear, complete Form 34B; the 3-page form's page 3 (form sub-page 03/12) carries both the header confirming CON 170 in standard column order (Odinga, Ruto, Waihiga, Wajackoyah) and the final dark-shaded TOTAL row. The automated green-shading locator found no distinctly green-shaded row (this scan's TOTAL row is shaded dark grey, not green), so the row was located by direct visual inspection and confirmed with a separate 500 DPI crop. The PDF has no embedded text layer (confirmed by direct extraction attempt). The printed registered-voters total reconciles exactly to the existing governed 2022 denominator.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image, then independently cross-confirmed with a separately rendered high-DPI crop of the same row (auto-located by green-shading pixel detection, scripts/p23/find_total_row.py). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.
